context.description: Group that contains the connector data-pipeline components. Defaults to the input directory name.

paths.description: Files or directories under the input root to inspect for Kafka Connect JSON and Strimzi KafkaConnector YAML. Left out, the whole root is walked.

broker.description: Transport name written on asynchronous handoffs. This identifies Kafka to flow composition without naming a live bootstrap server.

connectors.description: Estate-specific facts keyed by the connector's metadata.name or Kafka Connect name: its catalog store, the logical publisher for outbox events, and finite values used by dynamic outbox routing.

store.description: Catalog Store.id for the database whose log this connector reads.

sourceService.description: Service.id that logically publishes events carried through an Outbox Event Router. The channel is attached to this service, while Debezium remains the relay in the flow.

routes.description: Known outbox route values and wire message names. These values live in rows, not connector configuration, so dynamic routing is not enumerable without them.

value.description: Value of the column selected by route.by.field, aggregatetype by default.

message.description: Exact event name carried on the wire for this route.

topic.description: Exact Kafka topic when custom route.topic.regex logic cannot be evaluated from the route value.

out.description: Name of the catalog fragment inside the step's output directory.
